title: Disconnection of the Dexcom G6 transmitter with 80 days
body:
When the dexcom transmitter goes for more than half the connection starts to give problems until it already fails. We have reset hard, but there is no way. Changed sensors but this is not the problem. We need xdrip with native for Androidaps with the SMBs.
Our relationship with xdrip is not very friendly. I would like to approach a possible solution.
Thanks. muchas gracias
